reviews.comment: Really tough class, but Dogariu did an outstanding job teaching it. He is very understanding, all you have to do is communicate.

His lectures aren't that helpful, he rambles for 75 minutes. The first quiz was easy, and everything picks up really fast after that point, so make sure you don't fall behind. Reading the textbook and doing practice problems will be your best friend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Didn't really find the lectures that useful as they are a bit fast paced. That being said, he is very generous with grading, and will give you many points for partial credit. Overall, Dr. Do"goat"iu is very forgiving. He is lenient so long as you communicate with him. He makes the final and quiz 1 easy, midterm and quiz 2 are very hard
He's awesome at teaching such a hard subject

Dr. Dogariu went so fast in lectures that 9 times out of 10 they were unbearable. HW was a completion grade, did not prepare us well enough for the exams or quizzes when I took him. Used recitation time to lecture more rather than letting the TA recap everything and take questions. He's a 3/5 only because he curves like a pro MLB baseball player.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course was difficult but Dogariu was a great prof to take. Tests were very similar to review and homework so there weren't surprises. Quizzes were more difficult. Allowed a cheat sheet on both. His lectures are very boring but he posts the slides online, so I just paid attention to the highlights and examples. Curved class a whole letter grade.

Professor Dogariu is a nice man, but not a good teacher. His lectures are incoherent, messy, and with many errors. The book for the class was bad. The expectations for the exams were unclear. He is available for office hours and is willing to help you out. This course could be taught much better. I would not take this professor again.

Professor Dogariu is good at explaining a very difficult subject and he is a fair grader. He is very clear about how much his class will be curved, so you know where you are sitting after each test and quiz. Subject is difficult, but he explains it well. Could use better handwriting.

Dogariu is a good professor despite teaching a difficult class. The classes can be fast paced, but if you come to class prepared then you will get the most out of the lectures. He teaches well and is a reasonable grader.

Dr. Dogariu is a caring professor who makes great and organized lectures (he says what section of the textbook to read also). The course is difficult though since the problems can take more than 1 hour to solve, so it is not feasible for him to solve all the problems fully in depth. Thus, a lot of self study is required. He does curve also.

Dogariu is a very good professor. Thermodynamics isn't usually an easy course, but Dogariu understands it well and does a good job of explaining it. He talks and writes quickly in lecture, and he'll usually show the process for a problem rather than calculating it. There is a pretty difficult group project at the end of class. Textbook helps.
Good professor, must attend lectures to get material. Caring guy who won't fail you, just do the homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things
